column1: # THE MANIFEST -- what a change moves. One row per app.
# There is one app here and the `app:` namespace is kept anyway, deliberately.
# The namespace is what transfers to a real estate; the count is not. A
# fixture that drops the prefix because n=1 teaches a shape that breaks the
# moment n=2, and the system this mirrors has more than one.
# This is the ONLY label namespace 004 carries. No lifecycle labels, no
# verdicts, no intent, no registry -- those are conclusions, and 004 exists to
# get the environment/host distinction right before drawing any.
# `app:core` answers WHAT MOVES. It says nothing about where it is placed
# (APP_HOST) or how it behaves (RAILS_ENV). Three questions, three answers,

column3: the only app. The glob is the derivation -- a change is app:core because it touched these paths, not because someone said so
